newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares slip as market takes a breather.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares slip as market takes a breather.

text.p: Leading Russian shares slipped on Monday in quiet, low-volume trade as investors took a breather after recent highs, and dealers forecast lethargic market conditions to continue in the next few days.
The Russian Trading System 22-share index closed 0.67 percent down on Monday at 418.63 from 421.46 at the close on Friday.
"The market is consolidating after the dramatic gains of the last week, " said Brunswick director Martin Diggle.

LUKoil LKOH.RTS ordinaries edged down to $19.4 from $19.7 at Friday's close, while LUKoil LKOH_p.RTS preferred fell to $12.60 from $13.25. National power utility UES EESR.RTS edged up to $0.3614 from $0.3611 and Mosenergo utility MSNG.RTS was $1.397 after $1.415.
Alfa-Capital chief trader Mikhail Khaleyev said the market was fluctuating in a narrow trading range, mainly on Russian operators' activity.
"I think the market will consolidate...I do not expect any dramatic moves up or down," Diggle said.
Results of Gazprom's GAZP.RTS annual shareholders' meeting on Saturday had little impact on the market, traders said.
The gas monopoly said it had changed some of its rules on trade in its shares, including a charter clause saying only nine percent of the comapny could be sold to foreigners.
But a presidential decree limiting foreign ownership in the gas giant remains in force.
Western buyers therefore should not think Gazprom was going to offer more shares, traders said.
"I think the news of the AGM was nothing really sensational, and in line with what people were expecting," Diggle said.
News that oil company SIDANKO plans an American Depositary Receipts issue in early 1998 and a convertible bond later this year failed to affect the market either, traders said.
SIDANKO production units include Kondpetroleum COND.RTS, Varyoganneftegaz VJGZ.RTS and Chernogorneft CHGZ.RTS.
